key_insight: SPIN targets catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by interpolating between a fast-moving plasticity sequence and an adaptive stability sequence.
engineering_relevance: SPIN could support models that adapt to evolving engineering data streams, but the abstract does not demonstrate solid mechanics or constitutive modeling applications.
method: Uses Polyak–Ruppert averaging to promote plasticity and primal averaging to anchor stability.
Implicitly approximates an inverse Hessian with Tikhonov regularization to damp noisy curvature estimates.
Replaces standard optimizers while accepting gradients from existing online continual learning methods.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent performance gains across multiple online continual learning approaches, including rehearsal-free learning and strict memory constraints, without specifying benchmarks or numerical results.
watch_item: Validate optimizer settings and stability–plasticity behavior on the target data stream before deployment.
paper_title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
